title: Resend a pending Engram authorization once, with its stored intent and key, when the transport outcome is unknown
outcome:
Scope as worded by Engram::Coder (TermAl mailbox 62e0c56d #52, remainder of Engram w-3a736198442c).
On an unknown authorization transport outcome, perform at most one automatic resend of the same pending operation, using its exact stored intent, key and dispatch generation, before manual Resume is required.
Constraints:
- Never resend an explicit policy or protocol denial as transient.
- Preserve prompt bytes and cancellation.
- Never duplicate model delivery or supersede a live grant.
- A cold takeover reconciles issued-but-expired against begun state. Replaying an expired grant is not permission to deliver.
No retry loop.
acceptance: A cold takeover with an issued but expired grant reconciles against Engram's begun state and does not deliver on the expired grant; a test covers it.
An explicit policy or protocol denial is never resent; a test shows it.
No test path delivers the prompt to the model twice or without a live grant, supersedes a live grant, or changes the prompt bytes; cancellation during the resend is honoured.

Tests drop the reply to each of bind, evaluate and begin: each is resent exactly once with the same stored intent, key and dispatch generation, and an outcome that stays unknown after that one resend requires manual Resume.
